serves: H5 groundwork G3 (the live record) and the validation report section 7 (SR 11-7 ongoing monitoring)
status: declared before any number is computed. The statistics and windows are this directive's reading of its acceptance criteria. The thresholds are proposals only: Eleonora's decision on #950 row 8 stays parked, and no flag below is a verdict, a stop order or a decision rule.

gate.rule: the monitoring read of live (locked-tier) outcomes refuses to run unless the decision record is a file in docs/decisions/ itself, not in drafts/; the replay on development days (to 2025-12-31) needs no record

windows.unit: scored target days per lead, newest last; a window with fewer days reports its figures with the days it has and the label too_few_days

statistics.kupiec: proportion-of-failures likelihood ratio on the q95 miss indicator against 0.05; chi-square, 1 degree of freedom
statistics.christoffersen: first-order independence likelihood ratio on the same indicator sequence, in date order; chi-square, 1 degree of freedom

pit.edges: the published forecast's five quantiles (q05, q25, q50, q75, q95)
pit.bin: the number of quantiles strictly below the outcome

statistics.crps_ratio: mean CRPS of the published distribution divided by the mean CRPS of the benchmark on the same days, the grid CRPS of repo_model.metrics.crps_from_quantiles on the five declared levels; below 1 favours the model. B1 is as-of persistence; B2 is read from the record's protocol block when the record carries one
statistics.staleness: per source in a record's inputs.snapshots: calendar days from retrieved_at to the decision instant, against the source's release_lag.worst_case_calendar_days in metadata/sources.json (the largest of field_release_lags when the source has them); and the panel's last date against the decision day, against the same bound for nyfed_sofr. A source without a declared bound is reported, not flagged
statistics.pin: each record's code.pinned_sha against the transitions registered in metadata/live_pin.json

proposed_thresholds.note: Lens D's amber and stop thresholds of the five-lens review (#958) are not in the directive; these are the directive author's proposals from binomial arithmetic, for Eleonora to replace. They are only used to show what a reader would see in the replay.
proposed_thresholds.stop_rule: stop when both the Kupiec and the Christoffersen p-values are below amber_p_below on the same date, or the 60-day band coverage is below stop_below

replay.limit: no day after 2025-12-31 and no day in a locked tier is read; the replay reads each day's published quantiles and its realised spread, both already in the tracked record
replay.windows_reported: the first date of each month on which a flag fires, and for each regime of metadata/evaluation_splits.json the minimum 60-day coverage, the days under amber and under stop, and the Kupiec and Christoffersen p-values on the regime's days
replay.b1: as-of persistence of repo_model.protocol_benchmarks.b1_forecast on the published panel (digest 4ddc3882cd6d406b11e1088f8ff6195e16dde175a0ad6818abe40dd5bdac8999), for the days it can be formed
replay.reading_rule: the replay shows whether the 2021-23 and 2024 signatures would have fired. It is development data, not a verdict, and no threshold is chosen from it
